rp-grass-01.front: How much of BC is grassland?
rp-grass-01.back: Under 1% of the land, but about 30% of the province species at risk depend on it.

rp-grass-02.back: Lower: sage, valley to about 700 m. Middle: no sage, 700 to 1,000 m. Upper: fescue, inside the IDF above about 900 m.

rp-grass-05.back: In brushy draws, on timber edges and near water. DEW: Draws, Edges, Water.

rp-grass-06.front: How do you stalk a deer on open grass?
rp-grass-06.back: Use a draw or fold below the skyline, wind in your face, move when its head is down.

rp-grass-07.front: Hunting a grazing lease with cattle on it?
rp-grass-07.back: Not without the consent of the lessee or occupant (synopsis page 9).

rp-grass-08.back: Still subject to the Trespass Act (synopsis page 9).

rp-grass-09.front: When are rattlesnakes back in their dens?
rp-grass-09.back: Virtually all by mid October. They come out in March and April.

rp-grass-11.front: Who graze IDF grasslands in early spring?

rp-grass-12.back: California quail, pheasant and chukar; gray partridge came from Washington.
